content.short: Brex is a US spend platform with corporate cards, expense management, bill pay and business banking.
content.description: Brex, founded in 2017 by Henrique Dubugras and Pedro Franceschi and based in San Francisco, is a US finance platform companies use to manage corporate spend. It offers corporate cards, business banking accounts with yield, expense management, bill pay, reimbursements and travel booking, tied together with AI automation and accounting integrations. Brex is built for startups and larger companies that want real-time control over spending in place of legacy card programs and manual expense tools. Trusted by more than 35,000 companies, it sits at the center of card transactions, reimbursements and vendor payments.
